import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I restart the live editor', function () {
  this.result = { activePlugins: ['safeword'], evidenceClass: 'simulated-host' };
});
Then('the installed plugin is active', function () {
  assert.deepEqual(this.result.activePlugins, ['safeword']);
});
